svg.title: Conxol desktop — configuration generator
svg.desc: Vector recreation of the Conxol Generator screen: native title and menu bars, narrow activity bar, saved-session sidebar, Home and Generator tabs, Huawei template selector, interface service rows, BGP peers and shared settings. Example addresses are reserved for documentation.
svg.text: Write a template. Fill the rows. Copy the result.
Enter an IP/CIDR or subnet mask. Peer IP updates automatically; edit it to override.
